annotations.title: A city's districts ranked, or its best and least served areas

description: For a city with a district ranking page (today Vienna, Berlin, Hamburg, Munich and Rome): every district that has a score on that page, ranked by Walkably score, with reach, street quality and minutes on foot to eight daily needs for each. For any other city: the five best and five least served areas from its city page, and it says so. This server is for single places in a conversation. Lists of addresses and bulk use go through the Walkably API: https://walkably.org/business/api/

city.description: City name in English or the local language, e.g. "Barcelona", "München", "Hamburg". A country can follow after a comma: "Valencia, Spain".

country.description: Optional: country name or two-letter code (es, de, gb ...) when a city name exists in several countries.

limit.description: Optional: return only the first N districts of the ranking (1 to 100).

name: district_ranking
